settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Delivery times depend on your address and the shipping method you choose at checkout, where you will see the options available to you. Full details are in our shipping policy.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unworn pieces with tags attached can be returned within 30 days. Personalised (monogrammed) items are made for you and cannot be returned. See our refund policy for the full terms.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Every product page has a size guide, and many pieces include a "What's my size?" finder that suggests a size from your height, weight and preferred fit. If you are between sizes, the fit notes on the product page tell you which way to go.

settings.question: Can I personalise my order?
settings.answer: Selected pieces can be monogrammed. Look for the monogramming option on the product page, enter your letters, and they are recorded on your order.

settings.question: How does the wishlist work?
settings.answer: Tap the heart on any product to save it. Saved pieces are kept in this browser, so there is no account needed. Clearing your browser data will clear the list.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: Send us a message through our contact page and include your order number if you have one.

settings.title: Frequently asked questions
settings.description: Quick answers on shipping, returns, sizing and your order.
